decomposition.title: Pokémon Chess Battle
decomposition.premise: A strategic chess game where traditional chess mechanics merge with Pokémon battles. Players deploy Pokémon as chess pieces, and capturing triggers turn-based battles influenced by Pokémon types and moves.

keeps: core game mechanics and strategic board game genre

keeps: theme, characters, and creature battling elements

mechanics.description: players take turns moving their pieces on the board according to specific rules
pieces can capture opponent's pieces by moving onto their square
a player aims to threaten the opponent's king such that it cannot escape capture
engage in strategic Pokémon battles integrated in chess gameplay to capture or remove opponent pieces
place Pokémon pieces strategically on the chessboard
execute moves with each Pokémon piece based on unique abilities
inflict and manage status conditions during piece interactions
apply Pokémon type matchups to influence battle outcomes between pieces

spaces.description: The main chessboard where Pokémon pieces are placed and moved in a turn-based manner.

mashup.why: Capturing an opponent's piece triggers a Pokémon battle resolving the capture, integrating Pokémon battling mechanics into the chess capture process.
